dossier.headline: Qatar's Hormuz plan stalls as US strikes Iran
dossier.summary: Qatar has proposed a two-day bridge deal: the US would lift its naval blockade and release part of about $8 bn in frozen Iranian assets, and Iran would reopen the Strait of Hormuz on day two. Neither side has accepted. Trump confirmed 'minor' US strikes on an Iranian air-defence site on Qeshm Island, and Iran's security council chief called the US reply 'not convincing'.
why_it_matters: Hormuz access drives crude, India's biggest import-cost risk
A deal would extend the oil slide that helped Indian equities last week; a breakdown would reverse it
